review_comment: The added code constructs shell commands using user-controlled input via %u substitution without validation or escaping. User-provided URLs and configuration values are directly incorporated into shell commands executed via /bin/sh -c, enabling command injection. Replace the shell execution with parameterized subprocess calls that properly escape arguments and avoid shell interpretation.

User-controlled href is directly substituted into a shell command template without proper escaping, enabling command injection. The substitution replaces %u with href content that may contain shell metacharacters, then executes the resulting command via /bin/sh. Use shell escaping or parameterization (e.g., shlex.quote()) on href before substitution to neutralize special characters.

The code fetches RSS feed URLs via urllib2.urlopen without validating the destination, allowing SSRF attacks to internal network resources. The href parameter from external RSS feeds flows directly to the network fetch operation. Implement URL validation to restrict allowed schemes and destinations, such as validating URLs against an allowlist of permitted domains and blocking requests to internal IP ranges.

User-provided URLs are directly substituted into browser command templates and executed via shell without proper validation. The URL replaces %u placeholder in browser["path"] configuration, then the entire command string is passed to /bin/sh -c. Use shlex.quote() on the URL before substitution or pass URL as separate argument to avoid shell interpretation.
